name: Herrera del Duque (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a green cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Herrera del Duque (a castle on yellow and the bend of the Zúñiga).
history: The official symbols of Herrera del Duque, the arms and the flag, were approved by the municipal council and the Junta de Extremadura in 1992; the flag is square, white, with a green cross and the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: Herrera del Duque arms — castle and the Zúñiga bend
